schema_file: question_schema_v7_file layer with locators stimuli rubric and provenance.json
procedure_file: extraction_procedure_social_addendum_v1.4_social science Classes 6-10 on top of procedure v2.md

second_method.method: independent count of answer-side keys (58 numbered keys + 1 unnumbered match block(s)) + 1 question(s) with no printed key

count_gate.note: No difficulty distribution table is printed in this LBA -> quota_table 'absent' (ruling R-E6). Question side labels 1-60 monotonic, no gaps or duplicates. Answer side 1-25, [match block, 8 rows], 27-59; q60 (draw) has no key. Difficulty per question: easy 39, average 9, difficult 11, untagged 1.

method_notes: Pages: Q pdf 60 (heading, LO, q1-?) 61-64; A pdf 159 (heading, keys 1-16) 160-163.

Sections: s1 MCQ q1-5; s2 fill q6-15; s3 T/F q16-25; s4 '26. Match the following with suitable answers (easy)' q26; s5 one mark q27-36 vsa; s6 two marks q37-46 sa; s7 three marks q47-55 sa; s8 four marks q56-60 la.

KEY FORM: fill keys print the completed sentence (stored verbatim). Keys 27-59 print the question restated (or paraphrased, e.g. q43, q49) on the number line and the answer on the following lines -> the number line is not part of the answer; answer.value = the answer lines (wraps joined; bullets one step; a lead line ending ':' a heading); answer_as_printed = the whole printed key (as accepted for evs-4-12 at control rev 4).
q15 key had the split T/F heading appended in the text layer -> removed (heading-in-answer check).
Tags without '(' read as tags (q38 'help?Easy)', q60 '.Average)'); q56/q58 tags printed lower-case '(difficult)'/'(average)'; q57 untagged -> 'no difficulty tag'. q60 draw -> 'no answer printed'.
Transcription: evs_auto.py rules (as evs-4-01) + the overrides in build file build_14.py; marks per ruling R-E5; topic per R-E3.
